name: Qloud Task Builders Checklists
author: QuantumCloud

sections.description:
Streamline your workflow with Qloud Task Builders & Checklists, the ultimate project management and task manager plugin for WordPress. Organize tasks, track projects, manage teams, and collaborate efficiently—all from your WordPress dashboard.

Looking for a powerful, lightweight WordPress task manager and checklist plugin? Qloud Task Builders & Checklists delivers a complete project and task management system without leaving your website. Perfect for remote teams, freelancers, agencies, and internal operations.

Whether you need to build simple daily checklists or manage complex team workflows, Qloud helps your team stay organized, meet deadlines, and boost productivity with detailed dashboards, recurring tasks, and real-time reporting.

🚀 Key Features for Smart Project Management:

  • Structured Project Creation: Define project parameters by easily setting start dates, end dates, and target milestones.
  • Role-Based Access Control: Assign specific user roles within projects to maintain structured control:
    • Managers: Complete oversight to manage the entire project, update settings, and oversee all associated tasks.
    • Co-workers: Collaboration-ready access to work on, update, and complete assigned tasks.
  • Dynamic Task Breakdown: Divide large projects into manageable, bite-sized tasks. Assign due dates and set priority levels to keep your team focused on what matters most.
  • Automated Checklist Progress Tracking: Users can add detailed sub-task checklists within any task. The plugin automatically calculates and displays progress as a visual percentage based on completed checklist items.
  • Advanced Filters & Smart Organization: Quickly sort through workflows with instant status filters like Overdue, In Progress, and Completed.
  • Proactive Overdue Notifications: Never miss a deadline with automated alerts that keep managers and co-workers accountable.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the qloud-task-builders-checklists folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress admin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the new Qloud Tasks menu in your dashboard sidebar to start creating your first project!
sections.faq:
Can I use this plugin for personal task tracking?

Yes! While built for team collaboration, you can easily use it as a personal checklist and productivity tool by assigning projects to yourself.

Does it support frontend task management?

Yes, frontend management within community groups is fully supported via our optional BuddyPress Integration Add-on.
